info.name: Orchestrator API
info.description: API collection for Orchestrator: health, transcription status, meeting transcription, and email sending. Use environment variables `baseUrl` and `supabaseAccessToken` for base URL and Supabase JWT.

request.description: Simple health check. No authentication required. Returns `{ "ok": true }`.

Returns whether transcription is configured (Groq/AssemblyAI). Does not expose API keys. Use before recording to show setup instructions.

**Response:** `configured` (boolean), `provider` (groq-whisper | assemblyai | none), `hint` (string | null).

Transcribe meeting audio and get structured metadata (topics, action items, summary).

**Auth:** Bearer token (Supabase access_token) required when SUPABASE_URL is set.
**Rate limit:** 6 requests/minute (configurable via TRANSCRIBE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN).
**Body:**
- `audioBase64` (string, required): Base64-encoded audio; max ~6M chars (~3–4 min).
- `mimeType` (string, optional): Default `audio/webm`. Use `audio/mp4` for MP4.

**Success (200):** `transcriptRaw`, `transcriptStructured` (meeting_topic, participants, summary, action_items, etc.).
**Errors:** 400 (invalid body), 401 (unauthorized), 413 (audio too large), 429 (rate limit), 503 (transcription not configured).

Send email via Resend.

**Auth:** Bearer token (Supabase access_token) required.
**Rate limit:** 12 requests/minute (configurable via SEND_EMAIL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN).
**Body:**
- `to` (string | string[]): One or more valid emails (max 10).
- `subject` (string, required, max 500).
- `text` (string, optional, max 50000).
- `html` (string, optional, max 50000). Provide at least one of `text` or `html`.

**Success (200):** `{ "success": true, "id": "<resend-id>" }`.
**Errors:** 400 (validation), 401 (unauthorized), 429 (rate limit), 500 (RESEND_API_KEY not set or Resend error).
